JUDGMENT
NON-REPORTABLE
IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
                   CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
CRIMINAL APPEAL NO.1689 OF 2015
(Arising out of S.L.P.(Crl.) No.2544 of 2013)
         
   STATE OF M.P.
   
       ... APPELLANT(S)   
                VS.
   RAM KISHORE SHARMA
   
  ... RESPONDENT(S)
                 J U D G M E N T
Anil R. Dave, J.
1.
Though  served,  nobody  appears  on  behalf  of  the 
respondent.
2.
Leave granted.
3.
Looking at the facts of the case, in our opinion, the 
High Court ought not to have quashed the criminal charge 
framed against the accused-respondent.
4.
In  the  circumstances,  we  set  aside  the  impugned 
judgment  and  order  passed  by  the  High  Court  of  Madhya 
Pradesh, Bench at Gwalior.  The trial court to proceed 
with the trial. 
5.
The appeal stands disposed of as allowed.  
      
 ..............J.
 [ANIL R. DAVE] 
..................J.
[ADARSH KUMAR GOEL] 
New Delhi;
11th December, 2015.
